armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Two subcutaneous injections of Placebo (for Dupilumab) as a loading dose on Day 1 followed by a single injection once weekly (qw) from Week 1 to Week 15.

armGroups.label: Dupilumab 300 mg once weekly (qw)
armGroups.description: Two subcutaneous injections of Dupilumab 300 mg (for a total of 600 mg) as a loading dose on Day 1, followed by a single 300 mg injection of Dupilumab qw from Week 1 to Week 15.

armGroups.label: Dupilumab 300 mg every 2 weeks (q2w)
armGroups.description: Two subcutaneous injections of Dupilumab 300 mg (for a total of 600 mg) as a loading dose on Day 1, followed by a placebo alternating with single 300 mg injection of Dupilumab qw from Week 1 to Week 15.

interventions.name: Dupilumab
interventions.description: Subcutaneous injection alternated among the different quadrants of the abdomen, upper thighs and upper arms

interventions.name: Placebo (for Dupilumab)
interventions.description: Subcutaneous injection alternated among the different quadrants of the abdomen, upper thighs and upper arms

participantFlowModule.preAssignmentDetails: Out of 917 participants, 671 were randomized and 669 were treated in the study. Participants were randomized in 1:1:1 ratio to receive Dupilumab 300 mg once weekly (qw), Dupilumab 300 mg every 2 weeks (q2w) or Placebo qw.
participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: The study was conducted in 10 countries between 28 Oct 2014 and 12 Feb 2016. A total of 917 participants were screened in the study.
